db:init: pg_ctl status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { host="$(mktemp -d)"; pg_ctl -w -l "$PGDATA/db-init.log" -o "-k '$host' -c listen_addresses=''" start >/dev/null; started=1; }
psql -h "$host" -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'scrumify'" | grep -q 1 || psql -h "$host" -d postgres -qc "CREATE ROLE \"scrumify\" LOGIN PASSWORD 'scrumify' CREATEDB"
psql -h "$host" -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = 'scrumify'" | grep -q 1 || createdb -h "$host" -O scrumify scrumify
echo 'PostgreSQL is ready: role and database scrumify (UTF8)'
